items.why: Semis lead the AI-trade unwind; Nasdaq futures pointed lower as investors question AI spending and hot CPI revives rate-hike fears.
Catching the same AI de-risking as AMD, with yields pulling back and the Nasdaq set for another rough session per this morning's tape.

summary: Tech keeps bleeding as hot inflation data and AI capex doubts push a rotation out of growth into Treasuries and blue chips. The Dow holds up while chips lead the slide, and crude jumps on a bullish inventory report.
